# develop's required status-check contexts, as read from
# GET /repos/digithings-ai/digithings/branches/develop/protection
#
# This is the guard's input. It is a committed snapshot, not a live read,
# because `administration: read` — which the branch-protection endpoint needs —
# cannot be granted to GITHUB_TOKEN at all, so no workflow can read it.
#
# KEEPING IT TRUE
#
# Every line here is a name GitHub will wait for forever if the producing
# workflow ever stops reporting. So before changing branch protection by hand:
#
#   python3 scripts/enable_branch_protection.py status \
#       --repo digithings-ai/digithings --branch develop
#
# and then re-run the guard, which is the same read the human runbook does:
#
#   python3 scripts/check_required_policy_checks.py --live \
#       --repo digithings-ai/digithings --branch develop
#
# `scripts/set-branch-protection.sh` reads this file and applies exactly what is
# here — it holds no list of its own, so there is no second copy to drift.
# `scripts/check_required_policy_checks.py` executes that script and fails if the
# two ever disagree, which makes this file the single place a context is added.
# See docs/BRANCH_PROTECTION.md, "Ownership of develop's required contexts".
#
# The `--live` read also runs from .github/workflows/policy-gate-live.yml, but
# only on workflow_dispatch — it has no clock and is not on the PR path, because
# the read needs a fine-grained PAT that only Chris can create
# (docs/ops/policy-check-credential.md). That credential is not provisioned yet,
# so the dispatch currently prints SKIPPED and exits 0; a skip is not a green.
# Until the PAT lands, a hand edit of branch protection that nobody followed
# with the `--live` read stays invisible — so the runbook above is the story.
# See docs/BRANCH_PROTECTION.md § Keeping the snapshot true.
#
# 2026-10-29: re-read live (read-only GET of the endpoint above): develop
# requires exactly one context, `local-ci`, a commit status the local CI runner
# posts — no workflow produces it, so it is declared under `external_contexts:`
# in .github/policy-checks.yml. The three GitHub Actions contexts this file
# used to list (`Required checks passed`, `doc-links + agents-init`,
# `mypy — digibase + digikey`) are no longer in the live gate.
# `merge-queue` is deliberately NOT listed: set-branch-protection.sh applies
# this file exactly, and requiring a context only the queue posts would lock
# develop.

local-ci
